briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and DeepSeek R2 intensify AGI race as safety gaps widen

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate model releases amid regulatory scrutiny and compute shortages. US and China entities dominate funding while multi-agent security risks escalate. Prompt injection persists as the dominant production threat.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI ships o4 with 4.1T parameters; Anthropic counters with Claude 4 Opus; Google releases Gemini 3 Ultra; Meta and xAI drop open weights models; DeepSeek R2 tops benchmarks.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent, automotive, and BCI deployments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA ships Blackwell racks to xAI Memphis supercluster; Microsoft expands Stargate to 200k H200 GPUs; TSMC reports 3nm AI chip yields improving.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will protocol-level dialect negotiation become mandatory for all frontier model deployments by 2028?
